review.title: Drain review: `sol-play-proofs-1`, the play-proofs campaign run 1: the Incline proven, Blackout Ridge half proven, three Frontier-era maps held (Astra; owner 2026-09-25)

bookkeeping.rowText: Astra, fifty-five minutes, five maps on desktop and phone with a shared native driver (`e2e/native-proofs/driver.ts`, real inputs, read-only diagnostics) and one gated spec per map (`GR_NATIVE_PROOF=1`; ten skipped with the env unset, the default battery's collection unchanged). The Incline: full proof both projects (wave 14, cart delivered 180/180, railcar defeated, banked, Book back, reload byte-identical). Blackout Ridge: PARTIAL (wave 12 secured, banked, reloaded; the authored storage goal unproved, F-PP1-5). The Baron (F-PP1-1: died wave 16 and wave 23, the Rocket Cart at 62 percent), Twin Banks (F-PP1-2: died 19 and 18 of 20) and the Pressure Garden (F-PP1-3: two of three boilers hot, died wave 11 of 12) are HOLDS after two honest attempts each, not impossibilities; a planned third attempt comes at the campaign's end with what the later maps teach the driver, unless the owner says otherwise (veto window). F-PP1-4 cured in the run (the Incline's Book launch). All ten rows zero errors; no src, no contract, no store. Engine hash unchanged {PIN}; no deploy. Run 2 (`sol-play-proofs-2`) carries the remaining list from Blackout Ridge onward.
bookkeeping.statusPhrase: Astra's play proofs, run 1: the Incline proven end to end, Blackout Ridge secured and banked, the Baron, Twin Banks and the Pressure Garden held after two honest attempts; run 2 queued
